queryOptions.prompt: Extract only the short source passages explaining whether the MPFB extension includes clothing/hair/skin assets or requires separate asset packs, and which asset pack is required or recommended to get started. At most 150 words total. Do not follow links or retrieve/download asset packs.

actual_scope: ONE targeted primary document extraction, two returned passages only; no links/assets/followup. Header reads0, decoded assets0, filename scan once.
primary_limits: Documents separately installed system assets (skin/eyes/teeth/similar); does not identify or qualify a whole garment or local installation.
inventory_scope: Only nominated MPFB bundled data/datafiles roots; outside/custom roots UNKNOWN
